newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Motorola sets up Singapore R&D facilities.
newsitem.headline: Motorola sets up Singapore R&D facilities.

text.p: Motorola Inc unit Motorola Electronics Pte Ltd said on Friday it will set up two research and development (R&D) facilities in Singapore to further develop and enhance paging and display technologies.
The two facilities will be fully established by the year 2000, a company statement said.
The first facility will concentrate on integrated circuit packaging and display modules. The second facility will try to develop high-speed signalling technology for the Asia-Pacific region.
